# MANIFEST - module `widget` (vendor/raven/src/widget)

Files: window.c, theme.c, widget.c, style.c, paint.c, anim.c, layout.c, watermark.c, direction.c, registry.c, events.c
(no .m files). Each becomes `zig/src/widget/<name>.zig`, exporting exactly the symbols below and nothing else.

## Files of this module already written

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `zig/src/widget/widget_h.zig` | `src/widget/widget.h`: every flag constant, `rvn_slot_t`, `rvn_fx_t`, `rvn_xform_t`, `rvn_transition_state_t`, `rvn_widget_class_t`, `rvn_widget_t`, `rvn_popup_placement_t` (+ `RVN_POPUP_*`), `rvn_popup_t`, `rvn_layout_spring_t`, `rvn_ghost_t`, `rvn_shortcut_t`, `rvn_window_t` as `extern struct` (exact C layout), the inline functions (`rvn_widget_collapsed`, `rvn_widget_theme`, `rvn_widget_match`, `rvn_widget_material`, `rvn_widget_glass`) and a `pub extern fn` for every function widget.h declares (this module's, and the ones of core/locale, core/accessibility, widgets/menu, widgets/viewport, xml/xml_attributes it lists). Exports nothing. Verified: `check_unit.sh` on host, `x86_64-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-windows-gnu`. |
| `zig/src/widget/externs.zig` | the cross-module declarations the module needs: alias imports of the header units that hold them, plus a `comptime` list that fails if a needed name disappears. Exports nothing. |
| `zig/layout/widget_layout.c` + `zig/src/layout_widget.zig` | layout test: sizeof / alignof / offsetof of all 11 structs and 28 constants, C vs Zig (274 values, identical on macOS arm64). Generated by `python3 -I tools/gen_widget_layout.py` (re-run after editing widget_h.zig). Run it like `core_layout`: `cc -I include -I src layout/widget_layout.c && ./a.out` against `zig run --dep raven -Mroot=src/layout_widget.zig -Mraven=src/raven/raven.zig`. `check.sh` was not edited by this job; the integrator adds a step "3c" that copies the 3b block with `layout/widget_layout.c` and `src/layout_widget.zig` (`-I include -I src`). Checked by hand: 274 values identical. |

Import in a translation: `const widget_h = @import("widget_h.zig");` (from `src/widget`), `const ctx_h = @import("../core/context_h.zig");`, `const raven = @import("raven");`.

Type notes for translators:
- `rvn_widget_t.a11y` is `?*widget_h.rvn_a11y_t` (opaque: the struct is private to core/accessibility.c); `rvn_window_t.platform` is `?*plat_h.rvn_pwindow_t`.
- `rvn_widget_t.xml_child` takes `[*c]const xml_h.rvn_xml_node_t`; `style`/`theme`/`match` use the structs of `core/context_h.zig`.
- Enum-typed fields (`RHAlign`, `RWidgetType`, `rvn_popup_placement_t`...) are `c_uint`; their constants are `c_int` (cast with `@intCast`/`@as` where C compared them).
- The macros `RVN_WIDGET`/`RVN_WIDGET_VOID`/`RVN_API_GUARD*`/`RVN_WINDOW*`/`RVN_COLOR_INDEX`/`RVN_METRIC_INDEX` are not functions: expand by hand (see the header of externs.zig).
- Translate in this order if you want header-only dependencies: nothing in this module needs another translated `.c` of the module; each file only needs `widget_h.zig` plus the other modules' header units.

## Exports, file by file

C column: the exact definition in the `.c` file. Zig column: the signature to write as `export fn` (copied from the `pub extern` twin in the header unit named in parentheses; the compiler does not check an `export fn` against its `extern`). `static` functions are not listed and stay plain `fn`. Public `R*` functions use the types of `raven.zig`. There are no exported global variables in this module (`rvn_window_pointer`... are functions). Total: 304 symbols (counting Ris_free_edition twice) (watermark.c's `Ris_free_edition` and `Rwindow_get_watermark_rect` are also in window.c under `#if`: see notes).

## Cross-module declarations (externs.zig)

Everything widget/*.c takes from another module is already declared by a header unit, so `externs.zig` only aliases them (and checks the names exist). Needed header units and counts of distinct names used: `core/base_h.zig` (37: geometry, colors, alloc, string and array helpers), `widgets/common_h.zig` (54: `rvn_class_*` globals of registry.c, `rvn_xml_theme`, common widget helpers), `render/draw_h.zig` (19: draw lists, springs, painters, `rvn_window_pointer`), `core/context_h.zig` (14: `g_rvn`, `rvn_api_check`, pools, `rvn_invalidate_all_windows`, `rvn_windows_theme_changed`, `rvn_repaint_all_windows`), `core/thread_h.zig` (11: mutex, atomics), `platform/platform_h.zig` (3), `render/renderer_h.zig` (10), `render/font_h.zig` (8), `xml/xml_h.zig` (11), `xml/xml_watch_h.zig` (2), `core/handle_h.zig` (5), `core/jobs_h.zig` (4), `raven/raven.zig` (all public types and enum constants). C library: `memset`, `memcpy`, `strlen`, `strcmp`, `snprintf`, libm (`powf`, `fmodf`...) via `sys/libc.zig` or builtins.

## Notes and traps

- `window.c` exports `Ris_free_edition` and `Rwindow_get_watermark_rect` too (inside `#if`), with `watermark.c` providing them otherwise. `watermark.c` is listed in no build list (verified: nothing calls `rvn_window_paint_watermark`), so translate it last or not at all; if you do, both files must not export the same symbol at once (check which `#if` branch is active: `config.paid`).
- `rvn_widget_check`, `rvn_window_check` take `__func__`: pass the name of the public function as a string literal.
- Registry (`registry.c`) is data: `g_classes[]` of `&rvn_class_*` (declared `pub extern const` in `widgets/common_h.zig`) and the alias table; `RVN_COUNT_OF` is `.len`.
- `style.c`/`theme.c` index `colors[]`/`metrics[]` with `(int)role - (int)R_COLOR_WINDOW`; keep the `c_int` arithmetic.
- `window.c` (2.5k lines) is the biggest file; `theme.c` (1.1k) holds the built-in themes (large float/color tables).
- Layout verified only on macOS arm64 (C `enum` is `unsigned`, `bool`-like fields are `int`, no packing); atomics are `thread_h.rvn_atomic_t { value: c_int }` as on the non-MSVC build.

## Layout check removed (2026-11-13)

The C-vs-Zig layout check of this module's private types (layout/*_layout.c and its Zig side) was removed: every C file of
the library is translated, so no C code compiles the private headers any more and the header units are the only definition
of these types. `check.sh` step 3 still compares the public types (include/raven) with the C compiler, and step 3b the
system types (pthread, timespec, pollfd, dirent) the Zig code takes from std.c (layout/system_layout.c).
